WITH m AS (SELECT * FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31')
SELECT count(*) rows_, count(distinct member_id) ids, count(distinct member_key) keys,
 count(distinct join_date) jd,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM m GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(distinct join_date)>1 )) multi_jd,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM m GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(distinct home_store_id)>1 )) multi_home,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM m GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(case when is_current then 1 else 0 end)<>1 )) bad_cur,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM m GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)<>count(distinct member_key))) dupkey,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)) orphan_home,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE home_store_id IS NULL) nullhome,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, valid_from, count(*) FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_ver
FROM m

calls.statement: SELECT member_key, member_id, join_date, tier, home_store_id, marketing_consent, valid_from, valid_to, is_current FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>2 LIMIT 3) ORDER BY member_id, valid_from

WITH m AS (SELECT * FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'),
atjoin AS (SELECT * FROM m WHERE join_date BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to),
firstv AS (SELECT * FROM m QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from)=1),
cur AS (SELECT * FROM m WHERE is_current)
SELECT coalesce(a.home_store_id,c.home_store_id) sid, a.n at_join, f.n first_v, c.n current_
FROM (SELECT home_store_id, count(distinct member_id) n FROM atjoin GROUP BY 1) a
FULL JOIN (SELECT home_store_id, count(*) n FROM firstv GROUP BY 1) f ON f.home_store_id=a.home_store_id
FULL JOIN (SELECT home_store_id, count(*) n FROM cur GROUP BY 1) c ON c.home_store_id=coalesce(a.home_store_id,f.home_store_id)
ORDER BY 1

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member
  WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND valid_from = join_date
)
SELECT j.home_store_id AS store_id, s.store_name, count(DISTINCT j.member_id) AS new_members
FROM joined j
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = j.home_store_id AND s.is_current
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
